thread.title: Spotify, Apple Amp Up Streaming Music Rivalry |

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Spotify, Apple Amp Up Streaming Music Rivalry |
text:
The streaming music business is rocking.
Millions of consumers are signing up for subscription streaming music services or using ad-supported alternatives. And rival companies are turning up the volume to attract customers.
X The number of paid streaming music subscriptions is on track to reach 235 million worldwide by the end of 2018, says Futuresource Consulting. Spotify ( SPOT ) and Apple ( AAPL ) lead the market.
"Streaming subscriptions accounted for over half of all global spend on music last year," Futuresource analyst David Sidebottom said in a blog post this week. "In the first half of 2018, the upward trend has continued, tipping the vast majority of key countries beyond the 50% threshold."
Streaming music is helping overall music spending grow while packaged music and digital song downloads shrink, he said. Consumer spending on music grew 10% year over year in 2017.
